positions.name: SprintVelocityZephyrCausation
positions.frame: what explains this sprint's velocity outcome?
positions.why: Tanya's two statements read as one causal claim in sequence: the velocity figure is offered, then immediately attributed to the Zephyr integration as its cause. Read together they assert a driver-to-outcome relationship rather than two independent facts — the same causal read the March Sprint 4 retro established (Obs_TinaVelocity / Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock), now restated in this later retro without those prior positions being available in this pass's consult to attach to.
